end.summary: Explored sacred groves, Chipko, Bishnoi-related practices, baoris and rainwater harvesting.
end.parentNote: Dev practised explaining how roots reduce soil erosion, sacred groves help protect water and plants, and baoris store water for dry days. They used comparison and cause-and-effect reasoning, especially when explaining why keeping a tree can provide repeated benefits. Dev still mixed up the idea that only the government can protect forests; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Dev to name one action ordinary people can take to protect a local tree, water source or green space and explain why it helps.
